title: REPORT on the European Social Fund Plus post-2027
part_text: calls, further, for more effective social conditionalities in rules on public procurement and concessions;
part_context: Calls for rules governing the ESF+ to allow public money to be allocated only to those employers that respect workers’ rights and the applicable rules on working conditions; calls, further, for more effective social conditionalities in rules on public procurement and concessions; encourages the Commission to create a comprehensive database, supplementing the Eurostat data, to allow for the timely and reliable monitoring of developments in employment, living conditions and industrial relations;
